papers.title: Cohort Versus Nested Case-Control Designs for Predicting Early-Onset Gastrointestinal Cancer Using Electronic Health Records
papers.translated_title: 队列与巢式病例对照设计在利用电子健康记录预测早发性胃肠道癌症中的比较
papers.author: Fan, R.
papers.summary: Purpose: To determine how cohort and case-control study designs affect the discrimination, calibration, and feature rankings of EHR-based models for predicting early-onset gastrointestinal cancer. Methods: Using EHR data from an integrated health system, we developed models to predict EOGIC within 2 years after an outpatient visit among adults age 18-49 years at the time of the visit. We compared two cohort and five case-control designs. Models included L1-regularized logistic regression (LASSO), XGBoost, and multilayer perceptrons (MLP). Models were trained with nested five-fold cross-validation. We assessed model discrimination using area under the precision recall curve (AUPRC), area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC), calibration before and after isotonic recalibration, and similarity of feature rankings across study designs and predictive models. Results: AUROC does not depend on outcome prevalence, it is suitable for comparing discrimination across study designs with different outcome prevalences; however, it was less sensitive to variation in model performance in this rare-outcome setting. AUPRC estimated in case-enriched samples did not generalize to the incidence-representative population in the intended deployment setting. Raw predicted probabilities substantially overestimated observed risks under both study designs. Isotonic recalibration improved calibration, although residual miscalibration remained. Cohort-based feature rankings were more consistent across algorithms, whereas case-control-based rankings depended more strongly on algorithms. Conclusion: Study design substantially affects the discrimination, calibration, and feature-ranking patterns of EHR-based EOGIC prediction models. Cohort designs are generally better suited to EHR-based models for early detection because they preserve the outcome incidence and temporal relationship between the predictors and the outcome. When case-control designs are used for model development, models should be evaluated and recalibrated in an incidence-representative cohort that reflects the intended clinical setting.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：确定队列和病例对照研究设计如何影响基于电子健康记录的模型在预测早发性胃肠道癌症时的区分度、校准度和特征排序。方法：使用来自 integrated health system 的电子健康记录数据，我们开发了模型，用于预测18-49岁成年人在门诊就诊后2年内发生EOGIC的风险。我们比较了两种队列设计和五种病例对照设计。模型包括L1正则化逻辑回归（LASSO）、XGBoost和多层感知机（MLP）。模型采用嵌套五折交叉验证进行训练。我们使用精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AUPRC）、受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）、等渗重校准前后的校准度，以及不同研究设计和预测模型之间特征排序的相似性来评估模型区分度。结果：AUROC不依赖于结局患病率，因此适用于比较不同结局患病率研究设计之间的区分度；然而，在这种罕见结局情境下，它对模型性能变化较不敏感。在病例富集样本中估计的AUPRC不能推广到预期部署环境中具有发病率代表性的人群。在两种研究设计下，原始预测概率均大幅高估了观察到的风险。等渗重校准改善了校准度，但仍存在残余校准不良。基于队列的特征排序在不同算法之间更为一致，而基于病例对照的排序则更强烈地依赖于算法。结论：研究设计显著影响基于电子健康记录的EOGIC预测模型的区分度、校准度和特征排序模式。队列设计通常更适合用于早期检测的基于电子健康记录的模型，因为它们保留了结局发病率以及预测变量与结局之间的时间关系。当使用病例对照设计进行模型开发时，应在反映预期临床环境的具有发病率代表性的队列中对模型进行评估和重校准。

papers.title: Human infection incidence for West Nile virus and Usutu virus in the Netherlands: evidence from a longitudinal nationwide cohort, 2020-2023
papers.translated_title: 荷兰西尼罗病毒和乌苏图病毒感染的人间发病率：来自2020-2023年全国纵向队列的证据
papers.author: Grobben, M.
papers.summary: Background Ecological surveillance indicates (regional) establishment of West Nile virus (WNV) and Usutu virus (USUV) in the Netherlands. However, the incidence of human infections remains unknown. We investigated the incidence of WNV and USUV infections in the Netherlands in 2020-2023. Methods We applied a two-tiered serology approach based on protein micro-array and virus neutralization on the participants of the PICO cohort. Which is a well-described, longitudinal, nationwide population-based cohort. IgG data were used to estimate overall seroprevalence and infection incidence as the primary outcome, and to study antibody longevity. Study set-up enabled tracking of the period of seroconversion and linking of self-reported travel history. The analyses took account of the survey design and weights were incorporated to match the Dutch population distribution following census data. Findings Among 4281 participants, we identified 113 probable WNV and/or USUV cases, including 55 seroconversions. Thirty-six cases were confirmed by antibody neutralization, of which 12 seroconverted. Six confirmed seroconverters were identified as autochthonous infections. The overall weighted seroprevalence was estimated at 0.54% (0.21-0.87%) for WNV and 0.25% (0.09-0.40%) for USUV. The weighted cumulative incidence in 2020-2023 for autochthonous WNV and USUV infection was estimated as respectively 0.06% (95% CI 0-0.12%) and 0.04% (95% CI 0-0.09%). Interpretation The estimated infection incidence and seroprevalence of WNV and USUV suggest a substantial underdiagnosis of clinical cases in the Netherlands in 2020-2023. These observations highlight the need for increased awareness among physicians to identify cases and the need for continued paired syndromic-laboratory surveillance for these viruses. Funding This study was funded by the ministry of Health, Welfare and Sports, the Netherlands.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 生态监测表明，西尼罗病毒（WNV）和乌苏图病毒（USUV）已在荷兰（区域）建立。然而，人类感染的发病率仍然未知。我们调查了2020-2023年荷兰WNV和USUV感染的发病率。方法 我们对PICO队列参与者应用了基于蛋白质微阵列和病毒中和的两级血清学方法。PICO队列是一个描述完善的、纵向的、全国性人群队列。IgG数据用于估计总体血清阳性率和感染发病率作为主要结局，并用于研究抗体持久性。研究设置使得能够追踪血清阳转时期并关联自我报告的旅行史。分析考虑了调查设计，并纳入权重以匹配根据人口普查数据的荷兰人口分布。结果 在4281名参与者中，我们识别了113例可能WNV和/或USUV病例，包括55例血清阳转。36例通过抗体中和确认，其中12例血清阳转。6例确认的血清阳转者被鉴定为本地感染。总体加权血清阳性率估计为WNV 0.54%（0.21-0.87%）和USUV 0.25%（0.09-0.40%）。2020-2023年本地WNV和USUV感染的加权累积发病率估计分别为0.06%（95% CI 0-0.12%）和0.04%（95% CI 0-0.09%）。解释 WNV和USUV的估计感染发病率和血清阳性率表明，2020-2023年荷兰临床病例存在大量诊断不足。这些观察结果强调需要提高医生识别病例的意识，并需要对这些病毒继续进行配对症状-实验室监测。资助 本研究由荷兰卫生、福利和体育部资助。

papers.title: Fine-tuned encoders, generative large language models and typed decisions for classifying findings in chest CT reports: paired English-Japanese internal testing and external testing on naturally written Japanese reports
papers.translated_title: 微调编码器、生成式大语言模型与类型化决策用于胸部CT报告发现分类：配对英日内部测试及自然书写日语报告的外部测试
papers.author: fukui, y.
papers.summary: PurposeTo compare fine-tuned encoders, generative large language models (LLMs) and typed decisions (per-finding yes/no questions answered with a probability) for classifying 18 findings in chest CT reports, and to identify when typed decisions help. MethodsThis retrospective study used public data. The internal test set comprised 150 CT-RATE reports with paired Japanese translations at three quality levels; the external test set, 243 naturally written Japanese reports with human annotations (RR-Findings). We compared ModernBERT encoders fine-tuned on 20,444 reports, generative LLMs (gpt-6-luna, Qwen3.8-27B, MedGemma), and typed decisions with Jev, the Decisions API and Qwen. Thresholds fixed on 450 development reports were applied unchanged externally. The primary metric was micro-F1; case-level paired bootstrap 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated for 11 internal comparisons. ResultsEncoders were best internally (English 0.9853; radiologist-checked Japanese 0.9576) and exceeded Jev (differences 0.0367, 95% CI 0.0258-0.0484; 0.0336, 0.0215-0.0464). Externally, Jev (0.8844) lay within the encoder seed range (0.8656-0.9144), exceeded the three generative conditions tested externally (best 0.8564) and the Decisions API (0.8177), and had the smallest internal-to-external decrease (-0.0396). An encoder trained on 2,044 reports reached 0.8226 externally. Typed-versus-generated differences changed direction across models and test sets. At a fixed threshold of 0.5, Jev fell to 0.7753 externally. ConclusionFine-tuned encoders performed best with ample in-distribution labels. Although threshold-dependent, Jev, with thresholds fitted on only 450 labeled reports, fell within the encoder seed range externally and exceeded the generative LLMs and an encoder trained on 2,044 reports, making it an option when labels are scarce.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：比较微调编码器、生成式大语言模型（LLMs）和类型化决策（针对每项发现的 yes/no 问题以概率作答）在胸部 CT 报告中对 18 项发现进行分类的表现，并确定类型化决策在何种情况下有帮助。方法：本回顾性研究使用公开数据。内部测试集包含 150 份 CT-RATE 报告，配有三种质量水平的日文翻译；外部测试集包含 243 份自然书写的日文报告，带有人工标注（RR-Findings）。我们比较了在 20,444 份报告上微调的 ModernBERT 编码器、生成式 LLMs（gpt-6-luna、Qwen3.8-27B、MedGemma）以及使用 Jev、Decisions API 和 Qwen 的类型化决策。在 450 份开发报告上固定的阈值在外部未作改动地应用。主要指标为 micro-F1；针对 11 项内部比较计算了病例级配对 bootstrap 95% 置信区间（CIs）。结果：编码器在内部表现最佳（英文 0.9853；经放射科医生核对的日文 0.9576），并超过 Jev（差异 0.0367，95% CI 0.0258-0.0484；0.0336，0.0215-0.0464）。在外部，Jev（0.8844）位于编码器种子范围内（0.8656-0.9144），超过在外部测试的三种生成式条件（最佳 0.8564）和 Decisions API（0.8177），且内部到外部的下降最小（-0.0396）。在 2,044 份报告上训练的编码器在外部达到 0.8226。类型化与生成式之间的差异在不同模型和测试集间方向发生变化。在固定阈值 0.5 下，Jev 在外部降至 0.7753。结论：在分布内标签充足时，微调编码器表现最佳。尽管依赖阈值，Jev 仅在 450 份标注报告上拟合阈值，在外部仍位于编码器种子范围内，并超过生成式 LLMs 和在 2,044 份报告上训练的编码器，使其在标签稀缺时成为一种选择。

papers.title: A proteomic signature for prognostic stratification in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
papers.translated_title: 肌萎缩侧索硬化预后分层的蛋白质组学特征
papers.author: Lester, D. G.
papers.summary: Biochemical predictors of survival are essential to control heterogeneity and identify associations of disease progression in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). We performed high-depth Proximity Extension Assay proteomics using longitudinal serum (n=851) and CSF (n=244) samples from 426 people with ALS, replicated in a further 460 patients. Cox regression identified five CSF proteins, including tropomyosin 3 (TPM3), and 57 serum proteins, including neurofilament light chain (NEFL) and peripherin, associated with survival. Lasso regression identified an eight-protein serum panel, including NEFL, peripherin, EDA2R and CALCA -- reflecting both disease extent and progression rate -- that improved survival prediction beyond clinical parameters and NEFL: external validation c-statistic 0.78 versus 0.74 ({Delta} 95% CI 0.00-0.08), p=0.066; 1-year AUC 0.89 versus 0.84 (0.00-0.11), p=0.047. Joint modelling identified survival-associated trajectories of serum EDA2R and CALCA, highlighting their potential to measure disease progression. These findings identify diverse serum proteins that enhance survival stratification and are associated with disease progression in ALS.
papers.translated_summary: 生化预测因子对于控制肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）的异质性并识别疾病进展相关关联至关重要。我们利用来自426名ALS患者的纵向血清（n=851）和脑脊液（n=244）样本进行了高深度邻近延伸分析蛋白质组学检测，并在另外460名患者中进行了重复验证。Cox回归识别出五种脑脊液蛋白（包括原肌球蛋白3，TPM3）和57种血清蛋白（包括神经丝轻链，NEFL和周边蛋白）与生存相关。Lasso回归识别出一个八蛋白血清组合，包括NEFL、周边蛋白、EDA2R和CALCA——反映疾病范围和进展速率——该组合在临床参数和NEFL之外改善了生存预测：外部验证c统计量为0.78对0.74（Δ 95% CI 0.00-0.08），p=0.066；1年AUC为0.89对0.84（0.00-0.11），p=0.047。联合模型识别出与生存相关的血清EDA2R和CALCA轨迹，突显其测量疾病进展的潜力。这些发现识别出多种血清蛋白，可增强生存分层并与ALS疾病进展相关。

papers.title: Sequential rTMS-tACS Neuromodulation Is Associated with Increased Resting-State Theta Activity in Fibromyalgia: A Randomized Controlled Pilot Study
papers.translated_title: 序贯rTMS-tACS神经调控与纤维肌痛患者静息态θ活动增加相关：一项随机对照预试验
papers.author: Buran, O.
papers.summary: BackgroundSequential application of repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) and transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) may induce neurophysiological changes within sensorimotor and pain-related networks. However, the resting-state EEG effects of this combined approach in fibromyalgia remain unknown. MethodsIn this exploratory randomized controlled pilot study, 10 adults with fibromyalgia were assigned to active stimulation (n = 5) or a no-stimulation control group (n = 5). Active participants received one or two sessions of 10-Hz rTMS over the left primary motor cortex (1,000 pulses/session), followed by 10 daily sessions of bilateral 10-Hz tACS (1 mA, 20 min). Six-minute eyes-closed resting-state EEG recordings were obtained before and after the intervention or an equivalent control interval. Power spectral density was quantified in the delta, theta, alpha, and beta bands and analyzed using mixed repeated-measures ANOVAs across central-centroparietal and posterior regions of interest. ResultsTheta power increased significantly in the active group but not in controls, yielding significant Time x Group (F(1,8)=8.70, p=.018, p{superscript 2}=.521) and Time x ROI x Group (F(1,8)=5.53, p=.047, p{superscript 2}=.409) interactions. Follow-up analyses showed increased theta power in both central-centroparietal (p=.004) and posterior (p=.012) regions, with a larger increase observed posteriorly. No significant interaction effects were found for delta, alpha, or beta power. ConclusionsSequential motor-cortex rTMS followed by repeated bilateral 10-Hz tACS was associated with increased resting-state theta activity in fibromyalgia. Given the small sample size, post hoc ROI selection, lack of sham stimulation, and absence of component-specific control conditions, these findings should be considered hypothesis-generating and require replication in adequately powered sham-controlled studies.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）与经颅交流电刺激（tACS）的序贯应用可能在感觉运动和疼痛相关网络内诱导神经生理学改变。然而，该联合方法在纤维肌痛中的静息态脑电效应尚不清楚。方法：在这项探索性随机对照初步研究中，10名纤维肌痛成人被分配至主动刺激组（n=5）或无刺激对照组（n=5）。主动组参与者接受一次或两次左侧初级运动皮层10 Hz rTMS（每次1000个脉冲），随后接受10次每日双侧10 Hz tACS（1 mA，20分钟）。在干预前及干预后或等效对照间隔后获取6分钟闭眼静息态脑电记录。对delta、theta、alpha和beta频段的功率谱密度进行量化，并使用混合重复测量方差分析在中央-中央顶叶和后部感兴趣区进行分析。结果：主动组theta功率显著增加，而对照组未增加，产生显著的时间×组别（F(1,8)=8.70，p=.018，p{superscript 2}=.521）和时间×感兴趣区×组别（F(1,8)=5.53，p=.047，p{superscript 2}=.409）交互作用。随访分析显示中央-中央顶叶（p=.004）和后部（p=.012）区域的theta功率均增加，后部增加幅度更大。delta、alpha或beta功率未发现显著交互效应。结论：序贯运动皮层rTMS后接重复双侧10 Hz tACS与纤维肌痛患者静息态theta活动增加相关。鉴于样本量小、感兴趣区为事后选择、缺乏假刺激以及缺乏组分特异性对照条件，这些发现应被视为假设生成性，需要在有足够效能的假刺激对照研究中重复验证。

papers.title: A distributed, privacy-preserving platform for linkage of epidemiological data with pathogen genome sequences
papers.translated_title: 一个分布式、隐私保护的平台，用于流行病学数据与病原体基因组序列的关联
papers.author: Langevin, J.
papers.summary: Efficient and secure integration of epidemiological data with pathogen genome sequence data is essential for identifying genetic clusters, monitoring emerging mutations and targeting public health responses. However, this information is often collected across different organisations: epidemiological data is collected by public health units while genome sequence data is collected by diagnostic laboratories. Linking these sources often requires manual or semi-manual approaches, leading to unnecessary delays in identifying emerging outbreaks. To address this, we developed a proof-of-concept privacy-preserving distributed platform, SecureEpiLink, for automatic linkage of pathogen genome sequences and notification data across public health and diagnostic laboratories. SecureEpiLink uses cryptographic hashing to establish linkage, without exposing personal identifying information. This ensures that the resulting linked data can be used to identify the emergence of genetic clusters without identification of individuals comprising each cluster, with the original identifiable data remaining stored at source units. We benchmarked SecureEpiLink against manual linkage and another linkage service using HIV and HCV datasets from New South Wales, Australia. SecureEpiLink performed similarly to manual linkage and outperformed previously used linkage algorithms, with all errors attributable to data entry errors in the underlying dataset. Lastly, we demonstrate how SecureEpiLink can be integrated with automated genomic epidemiology pipelines. SecureEpiLink is available from https://github.com/jolenefarrell/SecureEpiLink.
papers.translated_summary: 高效且安全地整合流行病学数据与病原体基因组序列数据，对于识别遗传簇、监测新发突变以及指导公共卫生应对至关重要。然而，这些信息通常由不同机构收集：流行病学数据由公共卫生单位收集，而基因组序列数据由诊断实验室收集。将这些来源关联起来往往需要手动或半手动方法，导致在识别新发疫情时出现不必要的延误。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一个概念验证性的隐私保护分布式平台SecureEpiLink，用于跨公共卫生和诊断实验室自动关联病原体基因组序列与通报数据。SecureEpiLink使用密码学哈希来建立关联，而不暴露个人身份信息。这确保了所得关联数据可用于识别遗传簇的出现，而无需识别构成每个簇的个体，原始可识别数据仍存储在来源单位。我们使用来自澳大利亚新南威尔士州的HIV和HCV数据集，将SecureEpiLink与手动关联以及另一种关联服务进行了基准测试。SecureEpiLink的表现与手动关联相似，并优于先前使用的关联算法，所有错误均可归因于底层数据集中的数据录入错误。最后，我们展示了SecureEpiLink如何与自动化基因组流行病学流程集成。SecureEpiLink可从https://github.com/jolenefarrell/SecureEpiLink获取。

papers.title: Adjunctive Accelerated Theta-Burst Stimulation for Inpatient Treatment-Resistant Depression: A Randomized Clinical Trial
papers.translated_title: 辅助加速θ爆发刺激治疗住院难治性抑郁症：一项随机临床试验
papers.author: Mueller, C.
papers.summary: Importance: Standard repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation protocols are difficult to integrate into inpatient psychiatric care because they require daily treatment over several weeks. Accelerated intermittent theta-burst stimulation (iTBS) may offer a feasible augmentation strategy for hospitalized patients with treatment-resistant depression (TRD). Objective: To determine whether connectivity-guided accelerated iTBS improves depressive symptoms beyond routine multimodal inpatient care in hospitalized patients with TRD. Design, Setting, and Participants: This randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled clinical trial was conducted in the inpatient unit of the Department of Psychiatry, University of Oldenburg, Karl-Jaspers-Klinik, Bad Zwischenahn, Germany. Patients aged 18 to 65 years with unipolar TRD were recruited between May 2021 and August 2024. Interventions: Participants received active or sham iTBS targeting an individualized left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex site showing strongest functional anticorrelation with the subgenual anterior cingulate cortex using resting-state functional MRI. Treatment was delivered as 3 daily sessions over 10 weekdays (30 sessions; 54 000 pulses total) as augmentation to routine multimodal inpatient care. Main Outcomes and Measures: Primary and secondary outcomes were changes in Montgomery-Asberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) scores assessed weekly and Beck Depression Inventory-II (BDI-II) scores assessed daily during the 2-week stimulation phase. Exploratory outcomes included response and remission rates. Results: Of 57 randomized participants, 51 completed treatment (active, n=27; sham, n=24). The cohort exhibited moderate-to-severe treatment resistance (mean Maudsley Staging Method score, 10.9) and psychiatric comorbidity in 82% of participants. Active iTBS was associated with steeper MADRS improvement than sham (-3.54 points/week; 95% CI, -5.53 to -1.55; false discovery rate-adjusted P<.001), corresponding to model-estimated reductions of 12.06 versus 4.98 points (Cohen d=-0.89). BDI-II trajectories similarly favored active treatment, although with a smaller effect size (-0.23 points/day; 95% CI, -0.41 to -0.05; false discovery rate-adjusted P=.02; Cohen d=0.22). MADRS response rates were higher with active iTBS (42.3% vs 13.0%), whereas remission rates were numerically but not significantly greater (26.9% vs 12.5%). No serious adverse events occurred. Conclusions and Relevance: Accelerated connectivity-guided iTBS produced significant add-on antidepressant effects during acute inpatient treatment of TRD. Larger multicenter trials are needed to establish durability and optimize clinical implementation. Trial Registration: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT04832750.
papers.translated_summary: 重要性：标准重复经颅磁刺激方案难以整合到住院精神科诊疗中，因为这些方案需要在数周内每日进行治疗。加速间歇性θ爆发刺激（iTBS）可能为住院的难治性抑郁症（TRD）患者提供一种可行的增效策略。目的：确定连接引导的加速iTBS是否能在常规多模式住院治疗之外进一步改善住院TRD患者的抑郁症状。设计、设置和参与者：这项随机、双盲、假对照临床试验在德国巴德茨维申安大学奥尔登堡精神病学系卡尔-雅斯贝尔斯诊所的住院病房进行。2021年5月至2024年8月期间招募了年龄18至65岁的单相TRD患者。干预：参与者接受活性或假iTBS，靶向基于静息态功能MRI显示的与膝下前扣带回皮层功能负相关最强的个体化左侧背外侧前额叶皮层位点。治疗在10个工作日内每日进行3次（共30次；总计54 000个脉冲），作为常规多模式住院治疗的增效措施。主要结局和指标：主要和次要结局分别为2周刺激阶段内每周评估的蒙哥马利-阿斯伯格抑郁评定量表（MADRS）评分变化和每日评估的贝克抑郁量表-II（BDI-II）评分变化。探索性结局包括应答率和缓解率。结果：57名随机参与者中，51名完成治疗（活性组n=27；假组n=24）。该队列表现出中度至重度治疗抵抗（Maudsley分期方法平均评分10.9），82%的参与者存在精神科共病。活性iTBS与假刺激相比与更陡峭的MADRS改善相关（-3.54分/周；95% CI，-5.53至-1.55；错误发现率校正P<.001），对应模型估计的降低幅度为12.06分对4.98分（Cohen d=-0.89）。BDI-II轨迹同样有利于活性治疗，尽管效应量较小（-0.23分/天；95% CI，-0.41至-0.05；错误发现率校正P=.02；Cohen d=0.22）。活性iTBS的MADRS应答率更高（42.3%对13.0%），而缓解率在数值上更高但无统计学显著性（26.9%对12.5%）。未发生严重不良事件。结论与意义：加速连接引导的iTBS在TRD急性住院治疗期间产生了显著的附加抗抑郁效应。需要更大规模的多中心试验来确定持久性并优化临床实施。试验注册：ClinicalTrials.gov标识符：NCT04832750。

papers.title: Metabolome-wide analysis suggests antidepressant exposure counteracts risk of depression in fatty-acid pathways
papers.translated_title: 代谢组全分析表明抗抑郁药暴露在脂肪酸通路中抵消抑郁风险
papers.author: Tsai, S.
papers.summary: Antidepressants are widely prescribed, yet their biological mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Large-scale metabolomics and linked electronic health records provide a unique opportunity to characterise metabolic profiles associated with medication exposure. We investigated metabolic signatures of antidepressant exposure using 251 nuclear magnetic resonance biomarkers in UK Biobank (N = 222,911), with external validation in NESDA and ALSPAC (N = 6,082) and longitudinal analyses (n = 5,820, mean follow-up = 4.2 years). We identified 152 metabolites associated with current antidepressant use (PFDR < 0.05), characterised by elevated triglycerides and very-low-density lipoproteins. Current users also showed higher omega-3 fatty acid levels and lower omega-6-to-omega-3 ratios, both associated with lower depression risk. Metabolic profile scores significantly distinguished antidepressant users in both external cohorts (OR = 1.07-1.39, ROC AUC = 0.58-0.73). Longitudinal analyses identified nominal associations between antidepressant initiation and increases in nine lipid biomarkers (effect size = 0.144-0.229). These findings suggest metabolic signatures associated with antidepressant use may not be solely explained by underlying depression and are characterised by both potentially beneficial fatty acid alterations and adverse lipid profiles. Validation across independent cohorts and consistency with longitudinal findings strengthen our evidence, supporting insights into antidepressant mechanism and its relevance to cardiometabolic health.
papers.translated_summary: 抗抑郁药被广泛处方，但其生物学机制仍未被完全理解。大规模代谢组学与关联的电子健康记录为刻画与药物暴露相关的代谢特征提供了独特机会。我们利用英国生物银行（N = 222,911）中的251个核磁共振生物标志物研究了抗抑郁药暴露的代谢特征，并在NESDA和ALSPAC（N = 6,082）中进行外部验证，同时开展纵向分析（n = 5,820，平均随访 = 4.2年）。我们识别出152个与当前抗抑郁药使用相关的代谢物（PFDR < 0.05），其特征为甘油三酯和极低密度脂蛋白升高。当前使用者还表现出较高的omega-3脂肪酸水平和较低的omega-6与omega-3比值，二者均与较低的抑郁风险相关。代谢特征评分在两个外部队列中均能显著区分抗抑郁药使用者（OR = 1.07-1.39，ROC AUC = 0.58-0.73）。纵向分析发现抗抑郁药起始与九种脂质生物标志物升高之间存在名义关联（效应量 = 0.144-0.229）。这些发现表明，与抗抑郁药使用相关的代谢特征可能不能仅由潜在抑郁来解释，其特征为既有潜在有益的脂肪酸改变，又有不利的脂质谱。在独立队列中的验证以及与纵向发现的一致性增强了我们的证据，支持了对反抑郁药机制及其与心血管代谢健康相关性的见解。

papers.title: Mucin VNTR haplogroup associations with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis are not independent of rs35705950
papers.translated_title: 黏蛋白VNTR单倍群与特发性肺纤维化的关联并非独立于rs35705950
papers.author: Reynolds, C.
papers.summary: BackgroundThe MUC5B promoter variant (rs35705950) is the strongest common genetic risk factor for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF). MUC5B and MUC5AC contain variable number tandem repeat (VNTR) regions. Long-read sequencing resolves MUC5AC into three SNP-tagged haplogroups (H1, H2, H3) differing in repeat length, and MUC5B into two (H1, H2) differing in lineage but not length. The tags correlate with rs35705950, so whether a haplogroup effect is distinguishable from the promoter variant is unclear. MethodsWe assigned MUC5AC and MUC5B haplogroups from imputed chromosome 11 array data in 771 European-ancestry IPF Job Exposures Study participants (385 cases, 386 controls). Logistic regression adjusted for age, smoking, principal components and centre, with and without rs35705950. The same models were fitted in TOPMed (1,961 cases, 3,816 controls). ResultsMUC5AC H3 and MUC5B H1 were each associated with IPF (H3 OR 1.63, 95% CI 1.26-2.09, p=1.8x10-4; MUC5B H1 OR 0.71, 0.52-0.98, p=0.038). Both attenuated on adjustment for rs35705950 (H3 OR 1.10, 0.83-1.45, p=0.52; MUC5B H1 OR 0.82, 0.58-1.15, p=0.25). A MUC5AC H2 association persisted after adjustment (OR 0.69, 0.51-0.94, p=0.017). In TOPMed the H3 findings replicated (unadjusted OR 1.62, 1.47-1.78, p<10-15; adjusted 0.94, 0.84-1.05, p=0.26), but the rs35705950-adjusted H2 association did not: the estimate was null overall (OR 0.99, 0.88-1.11, p=0.87) and in men and women separately (1.00, 0.87-1.16; 0.97, 0.79-1.19). The MUC5B tag failed quality control in TOPMed. ConclusionsThe MUC5AC H3 and MUC5B H1 associations are not independent of rs35705950. The MUC5AC H2 association seen here did not replicate. VNTR haplogroup does not appear to contribute to IPF risk independently of rs35705950.
papers.translated_summary: 背景MUC5B启动子变异（rs35705950）是特发性肺纤维化（IPF）最强的常见遗传风险因素。MUC5B和MUC5AC包含可变数目串联重复（VNTR）区域。长读长测序将MUC5AC解析为三个由SNP标记的单倍群（H1、H2、H3），其重复长度不同；将MUC5B解析为两个（H1、H2），其谱系不同但长度相同。这些标签与rs35705950相关，因此单倍群效应能否与启动子变异区分尚不清楚。方法我们从771名欧洲血统IPF职业暴露研究参与者（385例病例，386例对照）的推算11号染色体芯片数据中判定MUC5AC和MUC5B单倍群。采用逻辑回归调整年龄、吸烟、主成分和中心，分别在有和无rs35705950的情况下进行分析。在TOPMed（1,961例病例，3,816例对照）中拟合相同的模型。结果MUC5AC H3和MUC5B H1均与IPF相关（H3 OR 1.63，95% CI 1.26-2.09，p=1.8x10-4；MUC5B H1 OR 0.71，0.52-0.98，p=0.038）。两者在调整rs35705950后均减弱（H3 OR 1.10，0.83-1.45，p=0.52；MUC5B H1 OR 0.82，0.58-1.15，p=0.25）。MUC5AC H2的关联在调整后持续存在（OR 0.69，0.51-0.94，p=0.017）。在TOPMed中，H3结果得到重复（未调整OR 1.62，1.47-1.78，p<10-15；调整后0.94，0.84-1.05，p=0.26），但经rs35705950调整的H2关联未能重复：总体估计值为无效（OR 0.99，0.88-1.11，p=0.87），在男性和女性中分别亦为无效（1.00，0.87-1.16；0.97，0.79-1.19）。MUC5B标签在TOPMed中未通过质量控制。结论MUC5AC H3和MUC5B H1的关联不独立于rs35705950。此处观察到的MUC5AC H2关联未能重复。VNTR单倍群似乎不独立于rs35705950对IPF风险作出贡献。

papers.title: Anatomical and spectral foundation of skin pigmentation bias in optical oximetry
papers.translated_title: 光学血氧测量中皮肤色素沉着偏差的解剖学与光谱学基础
papers.author: Wachter, F.
papers.summary: IMPORTANCE Monitoring hemoglobin oxygen saturation is a cornerstone of patient care across a wide range of clinical settings, with pulse oximetry remaining one of the most widely used technologies. Recent studies have identified skin pigmentation-related inaccuracies in these measurements; however, the biological and optical mechanisms underlying these limitations remain incompletely understood. OBJECTIVE To investigate the tissue compartments and wavelengths that drive skin pigmentation-related bias in oximetry using depth-resolved optoacoustic (OA) imaging. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS Prospective observational imaging study of n=46 healthy volunteers representing all 6 Fitzpatrick skin types (FST). EXPOSURES OA imaging of the tibialis anterior region during physiological oxygenation challenges induced by vascular occlusion, reperfusion, and exercise. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES A total of 3016 spatially resolved scans were obtained. Tissue compartments were segmented using a pretrained neural network. OA spectra, oxygen saturation estimates, responses to physiological interventions, and associations with skin pigmentation were evaluated across 41 wavelengths from 700 to 1100 nm. RESULTS Skin OA spectra closely mirrored the optical absorption characteristics of melanin, and OA signal intensities were strongly associated with FST, demonstrating a substantial influence of pigmentation on superficial oximetry measurements. Epidermal oxygen saturation estimates exhibited minimal changes during physiological interventions, especially in darkly pigmented skin. Skin signals showed pronounced associations with melanin-sensitive wavelengths, enabling FST classification based on optoacoustic skin signals. Pigmentation-related bias was greatest at shorter wavelengths and progressively decreased at longer wavelengths. In contrast, oxygenation measurements obtained from skeletal muscle were less affected by skin type and showed the strongest responses to vascular occlusion, reperfusion, and exercise. Depth-resolved OA imaging demonstrated that physiologically meaningful oxygenation information emerged only after propagation beyond the avascular epidermis into deeper vascularized tissue compartments. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE The combination of appropriate anatomical targeting, optimized wavelength selection, and correction for optical attenuation may represent a promising strategy for mitigating skin-pigmentation-related bias in oximetry.
papers.translated_summary: 重要性 监测血红蛋白氧饱和度是广泛临床环境中患者护理的基石，脉搏血氧测定法仍然是使用最广泛的技术之一。近期研究已发现这些测量中存在与皮肤色素沉着相关的不准确性；然而，这些局限性背后的生物学和光学机制仍未被完全理解。目的 利用深度分辨光声（OA）成像研究驱动血氧测定中皮肤色素沉着相关偏倚的组织 compartment 和波长。设计、设置和参与者 前瞻性观察性成像研究，纳入 n=46 名健康志愿者，代表所有 6 种 Fitzpatrick 皮肤类型（FST）。暴露 在血管闭塞、再灌注和运动诱导的生理氧合挑战期间，对胫骨前区域进行 OA 成像。主要结局和测量 共获得 3016 次空间分辨扫描。使用预训练神经网络对组织 compartment 进行分割。在 700 至 1100 nm 的 41 个波长范围内评估了 OA 光谱、氧饱和度估计、对生理干预的反应以及与皮肤色素沉着的关联。结果 皮肤 OA 光谱与黑色素的光学吸收特征高度一致，OA 信号强度与 FST 强相关，表明色素沉着对浅表血氧测定测量有显著影响。表皮氧饱和度估计在生理干预期间变化极小，尤其是在深色皮肤中。皮肤信号显示出与黑色素敏感波长的显著关联，使得能够基于光声皮肤信号进行 FST 分类。色素沉着相关偏倚在较短波长处最大，并在较长波长处逐渐减小。相比之下，从骨骼肌获得的氧合测量受皮肤类型影响较小，并显示出对血管闭塞、再灌注和运动的最强反应。深度分辨 OA 成像表明，具有生理意义的氧合信息仅在传播越过无血管表皮进入更深层血管化组织 compartment 后才出现。结论与意义 适当的解剖靶向、优化的波长选择以及对光学衰减的校正相结合，可能代表一种减轻血氧测定中皮肤色素沉着相关偏倚的有前景策略。
